{"sql": "WITH g AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr,
         sum(i.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017,2018)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  max(CASE WHEN yr=2017 THEN gmv END) AS gmv_2017,
  max(CASE WHEN yr=2018 THEN gmv END) AS gmv_2018,
  round((max(CASE WHEN yr=2018 THEN gmv END) - max(CASE WHEN yr=2017 THEN gmv END))
        / max(CASE WHEN yr=2017 THEN gmv END) * 100, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM g;"}
